devices.noNearby: Looking for computers running this app on your network…
devices.addressesHelp: A Public network is listed only if Windows Firewall allows this app on it. Other computers reach this one through these addresses.
devices.noAddresses: No usable network. Allow this app in Windows Firewall on your network.
devices.blockBody: It can no longer connect to this computer, and its requests are dropped. You can unblock it later under Blocked devices.
devices.blockHelp: A blocked device cannot connect to this computer. Its requests are dropped, and it only sees a connection failure. You can still see it in this list.
devices.pasteHelp: Paste the pairing text from the other computer.
devices.networkOff: All network features are off. This computer is not reachable.
devices.incognitoOff: Incognito is on. Discovery, sync and sharing are paused.

relay.badId: The relay device ID is not valid

sync.globalHelp: Applies to every row; rows can still differ
sync.blockManualHelp: This computer can't overwrite others with Sync or Refresh. Manual syncs from others still apply here.
sync.blockSourceHelp: Don't follow the chosen device automatically, on LAN or through the relay.
sync.blockAllHelp: Stop syncing out and stop following. Manual syncs from others can still come in.

sync.pushTitle: Send this computer's {{feature}} to every paired device that is online.

settings.miniPlayerHelp: When this window is minimized, a small bar stays in the corner with the cover, playback, and favorite. Close it with its cross; it returns the next time.
settings.miniTrayHelp: When this window is hidden in the tray, the same small bar stays in the corner. Turn both switches off for no mini player at all.
settings.closeWindowHelp: "Ask me" shows the prompt every time. Minimizing to the tray keeps the player running in the background.
settings.playbackHelp: Songs play from the original file without transcoding. Sound goes to the system's default output device.
settings.noFolders: No folders or files added yet.
settings.removeFolderBody: {{path}} is removed from the music folders. Its songs stay in the library as unavailable, with their tags, covers, favorites and playlists, and play again once the folder is added back. Nothing is deleted from disk.
settings.showUnavailableHelp: List songs from offline devices in the library and search, dimmed.
settings.exposeDefaultHelp: Whether songs that don't belong to a playlist are offered to paired devices.
settings.exposureHelp: Applied once, when a local song joins this list. Changing it later doesn't touch songs already here.
settings.exposeNowHelp: To change songs already here, use Expose all or Stop exposing all.
settings.problemsHelp: Files that can't be reached or failed to play.
settings.historyCapHelp: Older entries are dropped. Between 1 and 10000.
settings.historySyncHelp: When a song finishes, this computer stamps it in UTC and sends the change. Another device updates its list only when it has this on too. The same timestamp on two songs is ordered either way.
settings.historyStartup: Merge when this computer comes online
settings.historyStartupHelp: On startup, collect Recently Played from every paired device that also syncs it, merge by time, then send that list. Devices with sync off ignore it quietly, with no notification.
settings.historyPauseHelp: Recently Played on this computer does not record songs that finish.
settings.incognitoHelp: Nothing is added to Recently Played. This computer goes offline immediately and every device connection is cut.
settings.silenceHelp: After you decline a pairing request, that device cannot try again for this many seconds. You can still connect to it. Default is 60.
settings.silenceInvalid: Enter a number of seconds from 1 to 86400.
settings.conflictPolicyHelp: Shown when another device sends changes and this computer also has unsynced changes.
settings.noticeRead: When a notification is marked read
settings.noticeReadHelp: The number on the bell counts notifications that are still unread.
settings.noticeClearHelp: Ask shows the choice each time. The other two run immediately.
settings.networkIncognito: Incognito is on. Discovery, playback position, and the relay apply again once it is off.
settings.autoSendHelp: After you change a selected item on this computer, send that copy to every paired device that is online. This does not pull their changes. Follow, in Sync below, is what gets their copy.
settings.relayHelp: Connect to paired devices outside your network through your own relay. All four fields are required.
settings.relayIdHelp: The relay's certificate ID, so this computer only talks to your relay.
settings.syncHelp: Send pushes this computer's copy to devices that are online. Override replaces this computer with one connected device. Follow, in the table, gets that device's later changes automatically.
settings.requestDeviceHelp: Override starts with this device marked. Each click still lets you pick any device that is connected.
settings.downloadFolderNone: Not set. You'll be asked on the first download.
settings.lanPortHelp: Saved and reused on every start. Listening on {{port}} now.
settings.overwriteModeHelp: Applies to Send from any paired device. Choose Silent to accept it at once, or Ask to confirm first.
settings.portBusy: That port is already in use. Pick another one.
settings.portFallback: Port {{saved}} is already in use. Listening on {{port}} for now. The saved port is unchanged and will be tried again next start.

about.name: TunePeerly
about.summary: Plays the music on this computer and shares it with the devices you pair. Songs play from the original files.
about.licenseHelp: You can use, share, and modify this app. If other people use a modified version over a network, its source code must be offered under the same license.
about.sourceNote: The complete source code is in this repository.
about.author: Author
about.privacyHelp: There is no account. Your library, playlists, listening history, and pairing details stay on your own devices. Away from your local network, that data is sent through a relay server you configure, which only forwards it to your other devices. Devices encrypt it end to end with libsignal, so the relay cannot read it.
about.componentsHelp: Tauri, Rust, and React, along with other open-source components. Each of those projects keeps its own license.
about.creditsModify: A modified version may name its own author and redesign this screen. It must keep the original-work notice and state that it is a modified version based on work by zhebuilds.
